en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town nestled in a wooded valley. Dense historic buildings with ornate facades fill the valley floor and climb the surrounding hillsides. In the foreground are several grand multi‑storey hotels or spa buildings, while forested hills rise behind the town. At the bottom center of the image the caption in German reads "Blick auf Karlsbad." The style suggests an early–mid 20th‑century photographic postcard.
